name: Ritual of Xipe Totec (Necromancy Rituals, Advanced) (Pisanob)

system.description: The Necromancer flays a living victim's skin with an obsidian dagger (the victim must survive the flaying), then drinks a mixture of the victim's blood, octli, and amaranth so that he sweats a bloody sheen equal to one Blood Trait. Donning the skin allows it to absorb the vitae and heal over the Kindred's own flesh as a perfect disguise of the victim's identity, so long as the victim was of similar stature. The disguise conveys none of the victim's knowledge or mannerisms and does nothing to hide the wearer's vampiric nature. The skin requires nightly bathing in a Blood Trait's worth of vitae to remain viable, and removing it (with the same flaying knife) inflicts one unsoakable level of lethal damage and ruins the skin. Has no effect on Kindred or Lupines.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
